Container.Name: wyoming-onnx-stt
Container.Overview:
Wyoming protocol speech-to-text server for Home Assistant, running NVIDIA Parakeet / Canary models through onnx-asr and ONNX Runtime (CUDA or CPU). Drop-in replacement for wyoming-faster-whisper.
Defaults to nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (fp32) on an NVIDIA GPU. The model (~2.5 GB) downloads to /data on first start, so the first boot takes a few minutes.
GPU: requires the Nvidia-Driver plugin. Leave --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to your GPU UUID (or 'all'). Quantization (Advanced View - Post Arguments): blank = fp32 (best accuracy, ~2 GB VRAM). Enter --quantization int8 for ~1 GB, faster, slight accuracy loss. CPU only: remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters, set Device to cpu and Post Arguments to --quantization int8.
Home Assistant: Settings - Devices and Services - Add Integration - Wyoming Protocol - host = Unraid IP, port = 10300.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA GPU + Nvidia-Driver plugin for GPU mode (optional; CPU mode works without it).

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Wyoming protocol port. Point Home Assistant's Wyoming integration here. Change the host port if faster-whisper is still running on 10300.

Config.Name: Data / Model Cache
Config.Description: Model cache (Hugging Face downloads). Keeps models across container updates.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: onnx-asr model. parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 = recommended (fast, excellent English, auto-detects 25 EU languages). v2 = English-only. canary-1b-v2 = most accurate multilingual but heavier (~4-5 GB VRAM at fp32). Any onnx-asr model name can be typed in.

Config.Name: Device
Config.Description: cuda = NVIDIA GPU (needs --runtime=nvidia). cpu = no GPU (also set Post Arguments to --quantization int8).

Config.Name: Languages
Config.Description: Comma-separated language codes advertised to Home Assistant (e.g. en or en,de,fr). Parakeet auto-detects the spoken language; Canary uses the language HA sends.

Config.Name: Default Language
Config.Description: Language used when the client doesn't specify one.

Config.Name: Warmup
Config.Description: Run a dummy transcription at startup so the first real voice command isn't slow.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page, or 'all'. Ignored in CPU mode.

Config.Name: Punctuation and Capitalization
Config.Description: Canary only (Parakeet always punctuates). HA intent matching handles punctuation fine.

Config.Name: VAD Enabled
Config.Description: Silero VAD trims silence before transcription. Usually unnecessary for HA voice satellites (they already do VAD).

Config.Name: TensorRT
Config.Description: Use the TensorRT execution provider. Faster on NVIDIA GPUs, but the first start builds engines for several minutes. Keep Warmup on if enabled.

Config.Name: TensorRT Workspace (GB)
Config.Description: VRAM workspace for TensorRT engine building. Lower on small GPUs.

Config.Name: Zeroconf Name
Config.Description: Leave blank in bridge mode (it would advertise the unreachable docker IP). Set to e.g. wyoming-onnx-stt only if using br0/host networking with its own LAN IP.
